thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem — need to lock owners/timelines for remediation items: quota guardrails, scheduler knob sweep, and short-term headroom ops. I'll update the postmortem doc after we confirm.

Yusuf: I can take quota guardrails. Implementation plan: per-tenant soft caps, emergency fallback to lower-priority pool, and alerting on enforced throttles. I'll spin up a ticket + PR today. ETA: 2025-03-07.

ops-bot: Ticket created: RDW-3487 'adaptive quota + fallback policy' assigned to Yusuf.

Linda: Scheduler tuning here — will run a targeted knob sweep (batching window, prefetch size, eviction thresholds) and run perf matrix on staging. Need ~10 business days to validate across seq lengths. Coordinating with Devon for canary.

Devon: Canaries: I'll set up a dedicated canary pool and attach a trace header `x-rdw-canary: gpu-headroom`. Will also add a small query generator mimicking the spike profile.

Sam: Ops note — our overnight oncall got swamped during the incident. Propose a 2-week rotational floating guard (2 people x nights) and clearer pager escalation. Looping SRE.

SRE-Lead: Agreed. I'll draft a temporary rota, update the incident runbook with escalation matrices, and add an automated headroom alert: "gpu_free_pct < 15% for 4m" to page.

Jen: For the alerting rule, we can use the exporter metric: `gpu_free_bytes / gpu_total_bytes`. Example rule: `expr: (sum(gpu_free_bytes) / sum(gpu_total_bytes)) < 0.15`, `for: 4m`. Also recommend an accompanying alert on queue length: `gpu_queue_depth > 20 for 3m`.

Maria: Recording actions into the tracker now: Yusuf -> quota guardrails + rollback policy (ETA 2025-03-07), Linda -> scheduler sweep + perf tests (ETA 2025-03-21), Devon -> canary infra + generator (ETA 2025-03-12), SRE-Lead -> rota + alerts (ETA 2025-03-09), Sam -> ops rota proposal (ETA 2025-03-09). I'll attach acceptance criteria and tickets.

Yusuf: Acceptance criteria I'll add: zero user-visible spike in 5xxs during controlled quota enforcement; throttle rate < 1% after 24h; automatic rollback on error-rate delta > 0.5%.

Linda: Note — need the exact spike trace from 2025-02-28 to replay in staging. I'll commit the trace script by Friday.

Devon: Canary job scheduled tomorrow morning on the canary pool, will post logs to #incidents and the canary dashboard.

ops-bot: Reminder: follow-up sync set for 2025-03-11 14:00 UTC in #incidents.

Maria: If ETAs change, update the tracker before EOD Friday so the postmortem can be closed cleanly. Thanks all!"
